bundle_path.description: Local OKF bundle root path (up to 4096 characters where constrained); server enforces root and symlink boundaries. Example: /workspace/knowledge.

concept_id.description: Concept ID relative to the bundle, without .md. Example: architecture/cache.

direction.description: Edge direction relative to concept_id; omit for both directions.

kinds.description: Filter navigation/relation edge kinds; source provenance remains a separate result group.

limit.description: Maximum returned edges, from 1 to 100; defaults to 20. total/truncated indicate omitted edges. There is no cursor: narrow direction/kinds or use the whole graph within its byte limit.

as_of.description: Explicit reference time for temporal evaluation: YYYY-MM-DD with the date profile, RFC 3339 date-time with the instant profile. Omit to leave the request reference unset; pass a value for reproducible freshness.

temporal_profile.description: Temporal interpretation: date-3fcbb9f by default, or instant-0b87c52 for upgraded bundles. Match as_of format to the profile.
